subject: Fastlane: Renewal procurement & evidence runway for Q4 expansion
messages:
From: Eva Martinez <procurement@clearwell.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal window + Q4 capacity bump — fastlane request

Hi Diego / Laura,

We’re kicking off our vendor renewal for Clearwell Analytics and are targeting an earlier close to capture a Q4 seat uplift. Can we run this through your procurement ‘fastlane’ so we can get evidence uploaded and a PO issued within two weeks?

Scope: term extension to 24 months + 30% capacity increase across inference units.

What we need from you:
- SOC2 (latest) and DPA to attach to our vendor record
- A pre-filled PO template and routing instructions for our finance system
- Any procurement-portal instructions or a HubSpot/DocuSign link you prefer

I’ve attached a short renewal_summary.pdf with the numbers. Happy to hop on a 20-min call if helpful — procurement team is available Mon/Tue mornings.

Thanks,
Eva Martinez
Sr. Procurement Manager
Clearwell Analytics
Attachment: renewal_summary.pdf
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Eva Martinez <procurement@clearwell.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-25T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window + Q4 capacity bump — fastlane request

Thanks Eva — great timing. We can 1) kick the vendor fastlane flow, 2) surface required evidence, and 3) pre-stage a PO template for your team to sign. Proposed mutual action plan (short):

1) Today: I’ll open the fastlane kickoff and attach your renewal_summary to the ticket (see attached map_initial.xlsx).
2) By EOD +1 business day: Legal to confirm DPA and PO language (Laura).
3) Day 3: CS/Ops to publish SOC2 and credentialing checklist to the procure portal (Hannah).
4) Day 5: Pre-filled PO sent to your finance contact for approval + DocuSign link created (Kimberly).

Can you confirm the procurement contact for routing the PO (name + email)? Also confirm whether Clearwell requires our SOC2 + independent attestation or the full audit package. If you can upload whatever you already have into HUB-4512 (ProcurePortal id) that will speed things up — otherwise we’ll push the docs to you.

Short attachment: map_initial.xlsx — internal MAP with owners and dates. 

If you prefer a quick call, I’m available 2–4pm PT today.

—
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachment: map_initial.xlsx
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Eva Martinez <procurement@clearwell.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-26T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window + Q4 capacity bump — fastlane request

Hi Eva — looping in process steps so your procurement team knows exactly where to upload evidence.

Key portal steps (we’ll also attach a short markdown guide):
- Step A: Create vendor upload under HUB-4512 (ProcurePortal).
- Step B: Attach SOC2-report-2026.pdf (we accept both summary and full attestation).
- Step C: Upload signed DPA or indicate pending signature so Legal can approve PO language.
- Step D: Upload pre_filled_PO_clearwell.xlsx once you receive the DocuSign link.

We will:
- Pre-stage a DocuSign envelope (DocuSign link will be shared by Kimberly).
- Provide invoice instructions (net30 by default; alternate terms can be specified on the PO).

Attachments: portal_steps.md (short checklist), map_initial.xlsx (owners).

Action items for Clearwell: please confirm your AP routing email and the contact name. Once we have that we’ll generate the DocuSign envelope and assign the PO owner.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
Attachment: portal_steps.md
From: Eva Martinez <procurement@clearwell.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Hsu <claire@clearwell.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window + Q4 capacity bump — fastlane request

Diego / Laura — thanks for the clear plan. Confirming:
- We will upload SOC2-report-2026.pdf and our vendor attestation to HUB-4512 tomorrow morning.
- AP routing: ap@clearwell.com (Claire Hsu).
- Claire will approve the PO once the pre-filled template arrives.

We received the DocuSign preview link (https://redwood.app/docusign/exec/ABC123) — looks good. We expect to complete sign-off by 2026-10-02 which should allow the Q4 seat allocation to happen before October billing.

Forwarding our internal PO metadata below for your billing team:
- PO# forthcoming, please set invoice to: Clearwell Analytics, remit to 1234 Pine St., Suite 210, Sunnyvale, CA.
- Payment terms: Net30 (unless otherwise noted on final PO).

Thanks again — will confirm upload and ping when the DocuSign is completed.

Regards,
Eva Martinez
Sr. Procurement Manager
Clearwell Analytics
Attachment: pre_filled_PO_clearwell.xlsx
